findings.scope: Verified in the named GP archive. Current FeeBL corrects this in every pair_model.
Verified absolute 1e-6 bracket stopping criterion; forward-tail underresolution. New angle sampler is selected for pair_model>=1.
With both real-photon generation and loading disabled, the real-photon-off path bypasses virtual-virtual collisions. FeeBL independent dispatch requires pair_model>=1 and enabled pairs or muons.

With beam_pair=1, spectator storage is intentional and its records update the same counters as produced daughters. Interpreting those combined counters as produced-daughter yields increases the BH and LL expectations by 3/2 and 2. This is a population-definition/bookkeeping ambiguity; source inspection does not establish unintended spectator inclusion. Finite realized stored counts fluctuate. FeeBL separates daughter accounting for pair_model>=1.
Float velocity/energy rescaling is inherited in the named GP archive and FeeBL snapshot. This does not establish an identical HALHF failure in a pristine upstream run.

integration_specific_distinction: Exact-kernel proposal-density boundary handling and exact-kernel/host mass consistency were corrected in the imported QED extension, not attributed to pristine GP.
The later FeeBL transport exception exposed invalid states; the diagnostic itself is not an upstream defect.
No statement is made that every GP release or published collider prediction has these defects.
